## error-budget-tracker 1.0.1

- No user-facing changes; internal or metadata-only version bump.
- No updates to functionality or documentation.

Initial release of error-budget-tracker — a tool to make SLO error budgets actionable.

- Tracks error budget consumption across multiple services using SLI metrics
- Calculates burn rate and predicts when error budgets will be exhausted
- Alerts on error budget burn rate using multi-window thresholds
- Offers actionable recommendations: when to ship features vs. invest in reliability
- Generates detailed error budget and service status reports for stakeholders
- Includes command structure for tracking, alerting, and error budget policy creation
